description: SESA - VIGIDESASTRES - ESTABELECIMENTOS DE SAÚDE SOBRE SETORES DE RISCO - ES is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Camada do tipo ponto, com os estabelecimentos de saúde do ES em setores de risco. Esta camada foi gerada a partir da comparação das camadas 'CNES - ESTABELECIMENTOS DE SAÚDE ES' e 'CPRM - SETORES DE RISCO - ES', em que foram filtrados os pontos representando os estabelecimentos de saúde localizados dentro dos polígonos representando ... Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are CPRM, es, ESTABELECIMENTOS DE SAUDE, SESA, SETORES DE RISCO. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
